framework.ref: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 — Reg 106–107
framework.note: central; governs rights issue eligibility, shareholder approval requirement (prior to Board approval), and mandatory disclosures in the offer document.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 — Reg 30

framework.ref: Companies (Share Capital and Debentures) Rules, 2014 — Rule 13
framework.note: prescribes the form and manner of issue; requires filing of a declaration of solvency (if any) and prescribed forms (SH-7, etc.) with the Registrar of Companies.

framework.ref: SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 — Reg 3, 4
framework.note: during the rights issue window, insiders are restricted from dealing in securities; trading windows will be managed by the company's compliance officer.

framework.ref: NSE Listing Agreement / BSE Listing Rules — Chapter 9 (Rights Issues)
framework.note: procedural requirements for rights issue timelines, offer period, refund mechanism, and listing of rights entitlements on the exchange.

framework.ref: SEBI Master Circular on Rights Issues (latest revision)
framework.note: covers pricing (floor price formula based on market price), dissemination, underwriting norms, and allotment timelines.

headline: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited Board Approves Rights Issue
sum: Suvidhaa Infoserve's Board approved issuance of equity shares on a rights basis, as disclosed to NSE on 30 June 2026. The Board meeting resolution formalized the decision to proceed with a shareholder-access capital raise.
detail: The Board of Directors of Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited, at its meeting held on 30 June 2026, passed a resolution to issue equity shares on a rights basis. This is a primary capital-raise mechanism that offers existing shareholders the right of first refusal to purchase new shares pro-rata to their holdings, and is subject to shareholder approval and SEBI pricing requirements. The specific number of shares, issue size, and pricing ratio have not been disclosed in the cited announcement and remain pending formal regulatory filings.
